statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$. Write $R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\in D(\mathcal O_Z)$ for the *exact-support right adjoint* to $Ri_*:D(\mathcal O_Z)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$, characterized by $Ri_*R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\simeq R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(i_*\mathcal O_Z,K)$; affine locally for $X=\operatorname{Spec}A,Z=\operatorname{Spec}B$ it corresponds to $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(B,-)$ with its natural $B$-module structure. Suppose $i:Z\to X$ is a *pseudo-coherent closed immersion* (in particular any closed immersion when $X$ is locally Noetherian). Then: (1) $R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,-)$ sends $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ into $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$; (2) if $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $Z=\operatorname{Spec}B$ with $A\to B$ surjective, then for every $K\in D^+(A)$ the canonical comparison
\[
\widetilde{R\operatorname{Hom}_A(B,K)}\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,\widetilde K)
\]
is an isomorphism in $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$, and is natural in $K$.
hypotheses: i pseudo-coherent closed immersion; K bounded below quasi-coherent-derived; affine case A→B surjective.
conclusions: Exact-support right adjoint preserves bounded-below QCoh and coincides with derived algebra Hom on affines.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-twisted-inverse-image-closed}
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
Let $i : Z \to X$ be a pseudo-coherent closed immersion
(if $X$ is Noetherian, then any closed immersion is pseudo-coherent).
Let $a : D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X) \to D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Z)$ be the
right adjoint to $Ri_*$. Then there is a functorial isomorphism
$$
a(K) = R\SheafHom(\mathcal{O}_Z, K)
$$
for $K \in D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_X)$.

statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$. Write $R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\in D(\mathcal O_Z)$ for the *exact-support right adjoint* to $Ri_*:D(\mathcal O_Z)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$, characterized by $Ri_*R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K)\simeq R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(i_*\mathcal O_Z,K)$; affine locally for $X=\operatorname{Spec}A,Z=\operatorname{Spec}B$ it corresponds to $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(B,-)$ with its natural $B$-module structure. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ is a pseudo-coherent closed immersion. Let $a_i:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ be the right adjoint to $Ri_*$. Then for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^{+}(\mathcal O_X)$ there is a functorial isomorphism
\[
a_i(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_Z(\mathcal O_Z,K).
\]
The isomorphism is explicitly restricted to bounded-below quasi-coherent-derived inputs; it does not assert equality for arbitrary unbounded inputs.
hypotheses: X qcqs, i pseudo-coherent closed immersion, K in D_QCoh^+.
conclusions: The twisted right adjoint agrees with derived exact-support Hom on bounded-below inputs.
